itens.titulo: Prospecting methods: How to choose a warm, permission-based approach
itens.resumo: Prospecting methods are repeatable ways sales teams identify, prioritize, and engage potential buyers. Choosing the right methods matters more than choosing the right channels. The channel is often replaceable; the method usually is not.
